REBOUNDOPS / LOCAL DEVELOPER PREVIEW

Optional AI

Start without a provider, then understand the separate recovery and workspace AI settings.

On this pageStart with AI offRecovery review is a separate opt-inUnderstand limits and costs

Start with AI off

Intake, evidence review, manual requirement comparison, direction planning and backups work without a key. Recovery AI is disabled by default. The integrated demo launcher explicitly disables AI and removes known provider keys from its child processes.

Recovery review is a separate opt-in

The Angular recovery app can use server-side Anthropic review after local configuration. Follow the provider setup guide ↗ for current variables and model configuration. Environment files are not loaded automatically; keep keys server-side and out of Git.

  1. Add a job target and confirm the evidence you want considered.
  2. Inspect the exact JSON payload preview.
  3. Consent to that request only if you want to send those contents.
  4. Review suggestions yourself. They do not automatically change your session.

Claims and job requirements may contain sensitive information even when other fields are excluded. A changed session revision requires a fresh preview.

Understand limits and costs

Live recovery AI quality evaluation remains an open gate. Keep AI off for real-user pilots until that gate is met. Before a paid evaluation, set a provider-side workspace spend limit. Local request counters are not a currency ceiling and may reset without configured storage.

Workspace AI tools have separate settings and data flows. Recovery consent controls do not describe every workspace provider call. Check the tool and provider configuration before using private material.

Reference: evaluation and live-provider gate ↗. AI suggestions are advisory and do not predict hiring outcomes.
